text:
A great sequel to HM 1

The story ties everything up together, there's a lot of replay ability with each Fan, Jake/Son mask/techniques, and Beard's different guns. There is also a hard mode after beating the main story, and a secret level if you meet the conditions. Though certain hard mode levels can be excessive at times, it remains do able.

All round just a fantastic sequel and send off for the Hotline Miami series.
We shouldn't call games like this "Roguelites" anymore, we should call them Hadeslikes. It's the best version of this kind of game. Absolutely love it.

Amazing game. It's a almost like the baby of Hotline Miami and Doom. The music is great, gameplay is really fun and gets progressively more challenging. Loading screen tips are very funny and charming.

If this seems like something you'd like, don't hesitate.

100% worth playing with friends!

Big Walk is an absolute blast, especially when played with a group of friends. I’d highly recommend playing with all 4 players, as the game is at its best when you’re exploring and messing around together.

Going for 100% completion is genuinely worth it and gives you plenty of reasons to keep playing. There are a few sections that I found a little unenjoyable, but honestly, playing alongside friends made those moments much more enjoyable and completely worth pushing through.

Overall, if you have a group of friends to play with, I’d definitely recommend giving Big Walk a go. It’s one of those games that’s made so much better by the people you play it with.

Other than that, it's just more of Rogue City: Serve the public trust, protect the innocent, and uphold the law.

A simple and satisfying Solitaire + roguelike game with plenty of unlockables that let you experiment with new builds.

It reminds me of watching my dad play Microsoft Spider Solitaire back when I was a kid. 
Now I'm basically doing the same thing, just with more colors, more sounds, and a lot more going on.

If you loved Skyrim and other similar RPGs this game fills that itch. Systems feel more modern, side quests have purpose, exploration is rewarded and build crafting is fun. The scenery and graphics are gorgeous at times and the game runs well on modern hardware. Game runs a little rough on the steam deck though, 25-45 fps depending on where you are on the lowest settings. Overall really liked this game.

Played on 3 different systems via steam cloud saves,

RTX 5080 w/ 5800x3d
RTX 2080 w/ i5 9600k
Steam deck

Faig aquesta ressenya en català doncs és la llengua materna de l'autor del videojoc i també la meva. 

Sincerament, quan el vaig decidir jugar no m'esperava tot el que tenia per oferir, és un clar homenatge als Wolfenstein antics i barreja característiques d'altres videojocs de la mateixa estètica. A més a més, està ple de referències a altres videojocs coneguts com Skyrim i similars, i els secrets estan molt ben aconseguits. En concret m'encanta el de l'homenatge al grup de música Coure.

Caòtic, frenètic, visceral i addictiu, amb escenaris molt inmersius. Un gran representant dins del gènere, 10/10. I a més a més gratuït, res més a dir. Bona feina Roger!

Sheepo is a creative and concise metroidvania. It packs alot of fun platforming and exploration in 3 to 5 hours that never feels like time is wasted. It has the character that is familiar with Kyle Thompson's style and you can expect smooth gameplay to go along with it. You have to be really careful when designing a metroidvania entirely around platforming. Many titles end up being cumbersome but not Sheepo. Sheepo hits that sweet spot while avoiding ever feeling like a chore to navigate.

Amazing gameplay!!! Awesome graphics, but very demanding.

I completed the game 100%, and I honestly really enjoyed it! One of my favorite parts was discovering and exploring the world. The graphics are absolutely beautiful, and the attention to detail makes the world feel so immersive.

What surprised me the most is that this is an indie game. The overall quality, visuals, and world design are seriously impressive. I didn’t expect an indie game to deliver this kind of experience.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I’m really glad I played it!
